title: Two Work Packages write the same three story files and three fragments for legacy RWB-AD-006 on rwb-access
source: Work Package files _work/msr/wp/B-P4-02.md (fanout 5: legacy RWB-AD-002, AD-003, AD-004, AD-005 and AD-006, and the same three 'Write only' story paths and the same three fragment paths) and _work/msr/wp/B2-P4-005.md (fanout 0, the same three story paths and the same three fragments); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (three slices for legacy RWB-AD-006 on rwb-access: RWB-P4-AD006-CON in lane CG-W4, RWB-P4-AD006-APP in lane L-P4-A and RWB-P4-AD006-DB in lane L-P4-E, all wave 4, all disposition Split (rework)); _work/msr/gaps/B-P4-02-AD006.part.jsonl (3 rows) and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P4-02-AD006.part.jsonl (10 rows), the citation set the three delivered files carry
section: Whole story file set of RWB-AD-006 on rwb-access; fragments _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P4-AD006-APP.json, RWB-P4-AD006-CON.json and RWB-P4-AD006-DB.json
description: The plan carries three slices for legacy RWB-AD-006 on rwb-access (the contract baseline RWB-P4-AD006-CON, the application slice RWB-P4-AD006-APP and the ACE DB slice RWB-P4-AD006-DB), and two Work Packages of the run name them: B-P4-02, which lists RWB-AD-006 beside RWB-AD-002, AD-003, AD-004 and AD-005 with fanout 5 and wrote the AD006 key as part of that fanout, and B2-P4-005, which names the same three story files and the same three fragments alone with fanout 0. The six artefacts are present and complete in the tree, written between 17:03 and 17:54 on 22 November 2026: the APP file is 66,836 bytes, the CON file 49,098 bytes and the DB file 43,555 bytes; each carries the two header lines of Template and Rules v1 R8.1, a D-RCV-60 change-log row with the tool line T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, the 20 metadata rows of R7.1 in order with the values of this Work Package, the 19 section headings of R7.2 in order, the nine contract sub-tables 12.1 to 12.9, the R7.2 Level column in section 16 and no 'As built (monolith)' heading, because no slice of RWB-AD-006 is preserved, delta, secondary or new. The APP file carries AC1, AC2 and AC3 of RWB-AD-006 word for word with the origin tags (legacy RWB-AD-006 AC1 to AC3), the floor '20 characters' unchanged, and the one mock Given line the Work Package allows, on the decision-record library; the CON and DB files carry seven criteria each, all tagged (new, D-RCV-60), and they test only the contract artefact and the migration of break_glass_grant. All three keep the five legacy test case IDs TC-AD-006-01 to TC-AD-006-05 with their legacy Covers values and mint no -ITG copy. The three fragments carry the 28 keys the Work Package lists and parse, with release 30 June 2027, lanes L-P4-A, CG-W4 and L-P4-E, ready After RWB-P4-E1039-APP on the APP slice and Day 1 on the other two, H, C, I and X exactly as the Work Package fixes them, prd_ref Pending (C1) and the file path of its own story. The 13 distinct citation identifiers the three files carry (CG-B-P4-02-AD006-1 to -3 and ASM-B-P4-02-AD006-1 to -10) each resolve to a row of _work/msr/gaps/B-P4-02-AD006.part.jsonl or _work/msr/assumptions/B-P4-02-AD006.part.jsonl, and the 10 assumption rows carry the same semantics the files cite: the incident-status port, the 4-hour window as parameter data, the break_glass_grant table, the end and read operations, no published event, the clock as the authority, the reason bounds, the retention as data, the IAM approval reference and the one-active-grant rule. The content is sound and nothing in it is owed to this Work Package. The only finding is the collision itself: one legacy key, one set of three slices, two Work Packages, one set of paths, and one delivered citation set that names the other Work Package's registers.
evidence: _work/msr/wp/B-P4-02.md line 'Tool rules: AGENTS.md (root) rules 1-14. Agent: aisdlc-msr-worker. fanout: 5' beside its story lines for RWB-P4-AD006-APP, RWB-P4-AD006-CON and RWB-P4-AD006-DB, which are identical to those of _work/msr/wp/B2-P4-005.md (same acs AC1, AC2, AC3 and [] [] [], same tcs TC-AD-006-01 to TC-AD-006-05, same patterns DP03, DP05, DP13, DP19, same lanes L-P4-A, CG-W4 and L-P4-E, same ready values, same H, C, I and X, same release 30 June 2027, same disposition Split (rework)); both Work Packages list the same six output paths under 'Write only'. File sizes and write times read from the tree: 66,836 bytes at 17:54:33, 49,098 bytes at 17:03:21 and 43,555 bytes at 17:05:31, all 22 November 2026. Verification reads: the three files decode as valid UTF-8 with no replacement character; the metadata rows and the 19 headings were extracted and compared row by row and heading by heading; the gherkin of section 7 and the test case tables of section 16 were extracted and compared; the citation identifiers were extracted with a regular expression and each one was matched against the id field of the two B-P4-02 AD006 register files; the three fragments were parsed as JSON and their 28 keys and acs text_first_line values were compared with the gherkin Given line of their story. No source names an owner for the incident register, a field id for break_glass_grant or a right for the end and read operations, and those three absences are already registered once, as CG-B-P4-02-AD006-1, -2 and -3 with their ten assumption rows.
proposed: De-duplicate the plan: one Work Package per legacy key, with B-P4-02 keeping RWB-AD-002 to AD-005 and this key closed by whichever of B-P4-02 or B2-P4-005 is kept, and the other title withdrawn with its edit log row written whatever it decided. The delivered artefacts and their citation set stand either way, because their content is the same three slices and their metadata, criteria, test cases and contract tables already match this Work Package. If the coordinator instead wants B2-P4-005 to own the six paths, they must be rewritten from legacy RWB-AD-006 with a new set of citations of the form CG-B2-P4-005-n, which invalidates the 13 identifiers the delivered artefacts cite and the cross-references the sibling files RWB P4 AD002, AD003, AD004 and AD005 carry, and gains no content beyond shorter files (the style aim of 20-25 KB per file in the Work Package is not met: the three files are 66,836, 49,098 and 43,555 bytes); if that is chosen, the three B-P4-02 AD006 gap rows and its ten assumption rows must be retired rather than numbered beside the new set at step D1.
